annotations.title: Employment tribunal costs calculator (ET Rules 2024, rules 72 to 82)

description: Works out employment tribunal costs figures in England, Wales and Scotland under the Employment Tribunal Procedure Rules 2024: preparation time at the rule 77 hourly rate for the year the time was spent (£44 from 6 April 2024, up £1 each 6 April), final hearing time left out; a costs order with the £20,000 limit on a specified sum (rule 76), lay representatives' rates, witness expenses and deposits; the choice between a costs order and preparation time (rule 73(3)); wasted costs against a representative (rules 78 to 80); the 28-day deadline to apply (rules 75 and 5); and litigant in person costs in the Employment Appeal Tribunal (rule 34D, with the two-thirds cap). It applies the rates and caps to your figures and never estimates what a tribunal would allow. DMD Costs does not act in employment tribunals.

deposit.description: A deposit paid over to you by the paying party (r.40(8)), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

eatComparator.description: "eat": your own figure for what a legal representative would have been allowed, to check the two-thirds cap, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

eatDisb.description: "eat": disbursements (outside the two-thirds cap), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

eatLegal.description: "eat": paid for legal services on the proceedings, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

eatLoss.description: "eat": financial loss you can prove for the time spent, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

eatOrderYear.description: "eat": the year of the costs order (optional, for the other reading of the rate). The year beginning 6 April, as the calendar year it starts in, e.g. "2025" for 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026.

eatOther.description: "eat": other expenses, and the cost of expert help with the costs claim, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

eatRows.description: "eat": your own time, one entry per year it was spent in.

hours.description: The hours spent in that year, as a number such as "12.5" or hours and minutes such as "3:30".

year.description: The year beginning 6 April, as the calendar year it starts in, e.g. "2025" for 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026.

eatSameDayWitness.description: "eat": a witness allowance is claimed for a day also claimed as attendance time.

employee.description: "wasted": the representative is the party's own employee (r.78(3)).

forProfit.description: "wasted": the representative acted in pursuit of profit (r.78(4)).

layHours.description: A lay representative's hours charged, as a number such as "12.5" or hours and minutes such as "3:30".

layOrderYear.description: With a lay representative: the year the costs order is, or will be, made. The year beginning 6 April, as the calendar year it starts in, e.g. "2025" for 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026.

layRate.description: The lay representative's hourly rate charged, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

layWorkYear.description: With a lay representative: the year the work was done (optional, for the other reading of r.76(2)), in the same form.

legalCosts.description: The legal representative's costs claimed (your figure), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

mode.description: The tribunal and the kind of order: "et" (employment tribunal: costs or preparation time), "wasted" (wasted costs), "eat" (Employment Appeal Tribunal: litigant in person costs).

nation.description: With sent: where the case is proceeding: "ew" (England and Wales), "scotland" (Scotland).

order.description: "et": what is claimed: "pto" (a preparation time order: not represented by a legal representative), "costs" (a costs order: represented by a legal or lay representative), "compare" (both: represented for part of the case and not for the rest).

route.description: "et" with order "costs" or "compare": how the amount is decided: "specified" (a specified sum decided by the Tribunal, up to £20,000), "assessment" (detailed assessment, no limit), "agreed" (a sum agreed with the paying party, no limit).

rows.description: "et" with order "pto" or "compare": the preparation time, one entry per year it was spent in.

assessed.description: The hours the Tribunal assessed for that period, if it has (r.77(1)), as a number such as "12.5" or hours and minutes such as "3:30".

hearing.description: Of those hours, the hours at the final hearing (left out, r.72), as a number such as "12.5" or hours and minutes such as "3:30".

hours.description: The hours spent in that year, as a number such as "12.5" or hours and minutes such as "3:30".

year.description: The year beginning 6 April, as the calendar year it starts in, e.g. "2025" for 6 April 2025 to 5 April 2026.

seal.description: "eat": the seal date of that order, if different (YYYY-MM-DD).

sent.description: For the deadline: the date the final judgment (EAT: the final order) was sent to the parties (YYYY-MM-DD).

wasted.description: "wasted": the costs wasted (your figure), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

witness.description: Witness expenses for attending a hearing, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".
